I replied to Tobias in the thread in #central-random: the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is on ticket **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see the message himself. The open problem then was that the import file labels the doors E1/E2, while the booking sheet uses 01/02. That had to be sorted before anyone reimported, so they wouldn't end up with duplicates.
